verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage publishes per-endpoint API reference pages, a downloadable OpenAPI schema (confirmed retrievable by probe), and a first-party Postman collection that gives users runnable requests. The evidence never shows the reference pages themselves being interactive, such as an in-browser try-it console or embedded runnable examples. Missing for 10: documented interactive try-it functionality in the reference, runnable code examples on reference pages, independent hands-on corroboration of the interactive experience.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: ComplyAdvantage offers a Postman collection to help you on your integration journey... you can download the OpenAPI ("Swagger") schema
